title: Supply-chain logistics database dependency and round-trip case
description: Deploys the dependency-ordered multi-tenant logistics schema, captures the real administration-product output, recreates it under clean database and schema names, and compares table-space, key, referential, index, audit, CDC, and implicit LOB semantics.
prerequisites: Use an isolated authorized Db2 13 subsystem and replace every unverified environment value before execution
SCLDB, SCLRDB, LOGISTICS, LOGRPLAY, and generated child object names are unused
SYSDEFLT and BP0 exist and the authorization ID has required USE and object-creation privileges
The SQL processor accepts semicolon terminators and correctly converts the UTF-8 source file
The administration product can extract a complete database with dependent table spaces, tables, constraints, indexes, and implicit LOB objects
action_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SYSIBM.SYSTABLES WHERE CREATOR = 'LOGISTICS'

catalog_assertions: SYSIBM.SYSDATABASE has exactly one SCLDB row with Unicode defaults and the recorded storage and buffer pools
SYSIBM.SYSTABLESPACE has 67 explicit PBG spaces plus the implicit DOCUMENT_CONTENT base and required LOB space in SCLDB
SYSIBM.SYSTABLES has all 68 LOGISTICS base tables with the intended AUDIT, DATA CAPTURE, and APPEND attributes
SYSIBM.SYSINDEXES has all 260 explicit indexes plus the Db2-created DOCUMENT_CONTENT enforcing and LOB support indexes
SYSIBM.SYSRELS contains every declared relationship with RESTRICT delete behavior and no cross-tenant foreign key omits TENANT_ID
SYSIBM.SYSAUXRELS identifies the DOCUMENT_CONTENT BLOB auxiliary table for every created base partition
No table, table space, index, or referential constraint is left in an incomplete or advisory-only state
warnings: The expected SQLCODE and SQLSTATE remain null until live source execution is observed
Static generation does not validate Db2 prepare, allocation, implicit LOB naming, or product extraction/replay
expected.notes: The action query is a first existence check only. Retain statement-level setup results and execute the catalog review queries embedded at the end of the SQL file before extraction.

semantic_fields: database storage, buffer-pool, and encoding defaults
table-space type, partition count, maximum partitions, DSSIZE, SEGSIZE, locking, logging, allocation, and encoding
table columns, types, nullability, defaults, generated attributes, keys, checks, tenant-scoped foreign keys, audit, data capture, and append
index uniqueness, key order, clustering, storage, free space, buffer pool, and enforcing role
implicit DOCUMENT_CONTENT base and LOB support-object relationships
ignored_fields: internal identifiers and generated replay object names covered by the explicit name map
data-set names and allocation values that legitimately differ under the recorded replay storage policy
comparison_policy.notes: Compare source and replay evidence separately. Missing objects or empty evidence is a mismatch; a scoped catalog match does not make the overall case pass without source acceptance, actual product extraction, replay, and behavioral probes.
